note: Recorded generation response used offline (no token). Demonstrates SYS-010: bytes 2..255 have no SDD oracle, so those cases stay UNDETERMINED with a clarification proposal, even though the implementation returns MODE_INVALID.

scenarios.title: defined input bytes decode to their modes

oracle.statement: Byte 0 maps to MODE_IDLE and byte 1 to MODE_RUN.
oracle.rationale: MODE-001 and MODE-002 state the two defined mappings.

scenarios.title: undefined input bytes have no SDD oracle

oracle.statement: Behaviour for bytes 2..255 is not defined by the SDD.
oracle.rationale: MODE-001/002 define only 0 and 1; no requirement decides the rest.
oracle.proposal: Specify the intended handling for undefined bytes (reject with MODE_INVALID vs another default) and add a requirement id for it.

omitted.reason: MODE-003 (no persistent state) is a purity property with no observable state in this interface.
